# shahifa Online Shop

> Trusted online store offering gadgets, fashion, home & living essentials with free delivery and secure checkout.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products, categories, and storefront highlights.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse the full product catalog.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles, buying guides, and product news.
- [Search](/search): Search the store catalog.
- [Returns & Refunds](/returns-refunds): Return policy and refund process.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Customer account login and registration.
- [Orders](/orders): Track and review past orders.
